# BACILLUS SPECIES

For non-cereus or anthracis isolates, seriously consider as contaminant.

# For B. anthracis isolates, consult Infectious Diseases immediately.

# B. cereus treatment

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See

disease/syndrome sections for more information. No specific treatment is needed

for food poisoning.

For intravenous treatment options, please refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.
